_meta.description: Therapeutic-class membership for duplicate-therapy detection (DUPLICATE_CLASS_OF). Two drugs sharing a duplicate_class should not usually be co-prescribed.
_meta.note: This is a simplified class map for the prototype scope. NSAIDs, ACE inhibitors, ARBs, sulfonylureas, statins, PPIs, beta-blockers are the classes where duplication is clinically discouraged.

rico_note: ACE_inhibitor + ARB duplication is handled as an interaction (dual RAAS blockade), not just duplication.
